skill_name: Describe the effects of the current pandemic on food supply chain.
workflow: The COVID-19 pandemic has disrupted many aspects of the global food supply chain. It has affected the producers, transportation, and storage of food, due to disrupted supply chains, issues with personnel and equipment, and even changes in the behaviour of consumers. There have been issues with product availability in some regions due to shortages of certain items. In addition, food production and transportation have decreased due to factory closures and limits on the transportation of food items
